predictions_evaluation.P6 (Fuzzed strings reach dangerous sinks: CONFIRMED: Without isolated tempdir and RECORD_AND_STUB policy, os.system and pickle.load touch real system.
predictions_evaluation.P7 (process_students script fails on con: CONFIRMED: Calling process_students() fails with FileNotFoundError: config.txt if file is missing.

predictions_evaluation.P9 (Contract blocks float/external_io wi: CONFIRMED: Strict contract forbids float variation in calculate_average and IO hoist in process_students without relaxation offers.
